description: Records the channels of a polyphonic cable to disc as a multitrack file, from one channel up to sixteen

params.text: Starts recording, and stops it when pressed a second time
Stops the recording and writes the file

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable to be recorded; each of its channels becomes a track
A trigger stops the recording and writes the file

notes: the display counts the length of the recording, and the two lamps show that recording is under way and that the file is being written afterwards
the first press of the START button opens a dialog for choosing the file to record into, and that dialog opens again before every recording while AUTO ENUMERATE SAVES is switched off
menu: Use START button as TOGGLE (Start-Stop) — makes the START button start and stop the recording in turn rather than start it only
Consolidate Tracks after Recording — drops any track with nothing recorded on it as the file is written
1 channel WAVE files — writes a separate track as a single channel WAVE file, and 1 channel RAW PCM 32bit IEEE FLOAT files as a single channel float file
1 channel WAVE files — writes a separate track as a single channel WAVE file, with 1 channel RAW PCM 32bit IEEE FLOAT files as the other choice
CHOOSE destination file... — picks the file the next recording is written to
AUTO ENUMERATE SAVES — numbers each new save, so a fresh file is written without asking for a name
